answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Each submission hangs on the gale of a task receipt, and the meadow is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, reset on any identity-link attempt, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Reaching the walnut of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
